body:
The exact official transition exports are now retrieved and independently replayed. [Published source audit and reproduction bundle](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/155f719b85130367bff37f7d514c60dcb3a66502/experiments/2026-10-25_1857_codex_nontryptic-transition-lineage/README.md); Presto155f719, pinned reader Hitlist0263dc6 / PR850. This is source qualification, not a model fit.

- DirectSpike: 151,291 bytes, SHA256 d359bf7b8afd0ade9df9539d941c0f7931b8c39657a444d3bf8025e54ff1d995; 2,592 transition rows, 432 peptide/form/replicate groups, six product ions per group.
- hipMHC: 69,651 bytes, SHA256 8426f43364ea1d84244403811956f501664abf8001e7043ec8fc1ae546175308; 1,092 rows, 252 groups. 140 groups contain six products plus precursor, 112 contain precursor only.
- All 42,941 stored export cells replay with independent OOXML/openpyxl checks. There are no duplicate transition identity keys. DirectSpike's 1,296 absent Concat entries are missing values, not nonempty contradictions.
- All 54 reported export forms have unique S6B correspondences by sequence, explicitly labeled positions and reported total nominal shift. This does **not** resolve the S6A isotope-atom conflict.
- All 684 group sums replay. S3A sums agree within relative1e-6 for144/213 ordinal candidates, with a maximum46.63% relative discrepancy. Do not assert complete reconstruction or select a matching subset/scale.
- S3B product-only sums agree for105/117 numeric ordinal candidates; adding precursor yields only1/117. Maximum product-only discrepancy is0.5494%. Source-reported signals and derived sums must remain separate measurement records.
- **Ordinal acquisition mapping is unsafe:** at100fmol the export has labels1/3, while S3B has values in C/D and blank E for all nine peptides. All135slots have form/dose candidates, but only117 have both a numeric source value and an ordinal-equals-suffix candidate. Do not rename D as run3 based on numerical resemblance or infer a cause for the blank.
- The initial Presto audit's missing S3B candidates came from a bare-versus-modified lookup bug; the corrected audit and original failed interpretation are both preserved.

The schema prerequisite for source-faithful curation is now satisfied. Keep nominal amount, source-reported signal, derived sum, precursor signal, isotope assertion and candidate lineage distinct. Preserve unresolved acquisition/specimen/aliquot IDs, aggregation exclusions and isotope chemistry as typed unknowns. DirectSpike's separate N-column dose legend is not row-aligned metadata.

Remaining requests: exact quantification-transition inclusion/exclusion and correction rules; source-backed S3-column to acquisition links; resolution or explicit competing isotope claims; typed source/package/recipe implementation. A later peptide-grouped empirical response test can declare the selected-panel nominal-dose endpoint without claiming native MS1 transfer or APC concentration supervision. No old biological held-outs were reopened.
